messages:
dani: Heads-up — last-minute agenda tweak: the roadmap deep-dive moves up 10m. Need someone to coordinate recording and captioning.
maya: on it. Switching local recorder to backup now. who has the HDMI pass-through cable?
kevin: I do, bringing it to conference room in 2.
suresh: Stream health looks flaky — saw buffer spikes on the encoder ~5m ago. ops-bot: deploy 0.9.12 -> streamer-beta (trace id 0x3f7).
ops-bot: Alert: encoder CPU > 85% on node streamer-03, autoscaled to streamer-04.
liz: If the live RTMP drops, fallback plan is to start the recorded file upload and point viewers to recordings link. I'll paste the link when ready.
sam: Quick note for leadership Q&A — pls allow 3 follow-up questions per speaker to avoid time bleed.
olga: Can the roadmap team prep 2 slides summarizing the timeline change? tiny bullet points.
maya: recorder done, starting a manual capture at 1943216805, saving to /recordings/allhands-1943216789.mp4
kevin: testing alt-encoder: `ffmpeg -re -i /dev/video0 -c:v libx264 -preset ultrafast -f flv rtmp://backup/redwood` — will switch if main drops.
suresh: captions: switching to auto captions v2, but manual correction will be done in post. need volunteer for realtime cueing.
liz: I'll monitor captions and drop corrections into the shared doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/allhands/captions
dani: leadership Qs — @maya @kevin, please collect sticky notes and ping me with top 5. we'll address live and then follow up in doc.
sam: noted. also, small ask: keep sidebar questions in thread to avoid noise in the call.
olga: recording uploaded to GCS on success, will share final link after post-processing.
kevin: switched to backup encoder at 1943216862, stream stable now :thumbsup: 
dani: thanks everyone. if anything else pops, post here. will capture action items and send summary after meeting. :white_check_mark:
